The Scorned Wilderness is finally here in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0, and this is the ultimate guide to completing the game's first raid and defeating Kuldra, the God-Eater. I'll walk you through everything you need to know, including how to start the raid, what gear and supplies to bring, navigating the Scorned Wilderness, important encounters and puzzles, and how to reach the final Kuldra fight.

I'll also cover the Kuldra boss fight, raid mechanics, checkpoints, new materials, endgame progression, and the rewards you can earn from completing the raid. Whether you're tackling the Scorned Wilderness solo or with friends, this guide will help you make it through Dragonwilds' 1.0 endgame.
